text:
Ivy Chen: Quick design ping — validating the new Console > API Keys modal. Two contenders: (1) persistent inline errors shown after blur with a small "Required" hint; (2) compact submit-summary that appears only after save and links to fields. Main tradeoffs: modal height, keyboard flow, and SR clarity. Thoughts? Marco Silva: Inline-first. People expect feedback next to inputs in modals. Summary-only feels like hiding the problem. Zoe Patel: Inline if space allows; otherwise summary fallback. For summary we must move focus to it and make each link shift focus to the field AND announce the error. Riley Ng: Implementation note: backend returns keys like api_keys[0].label. We'll map to ids data-field-id="api_keys-0-label" so anchors are stable. Also reserve 18px under each field to avoid layout jumps. Ivy Chen: Copy suggestion: inline -> "Label is required"; summary header -> "2 problems prevent saving" with list items like "Label Fix". Required marker: show asterisk visually + an sr-only "Required" text. Marco Silva: For destructives (revoke key) we discussed typed-confirm for keys that are tied to infra; modal + undo for quick revokes. Typed-confirm should be forgiving (trim + case-insensitive) and show a monospace input. Zoe Patel: ARIA snippet for inline errors we can include in the pattern library: ```
Label is required
``` Also: when summary appears, use `tabindex="-1"` and `aria-live="polite"` then set focus to it. Linty (a11y-bot): Accessibility checklist: 1) focus to summary or first errored field, 2) inline uses role=alert, 3) required marker SR text present, 4) keyboard-only flow tested, 5) no layout shift. Riley Ng: Tiny visual nit: animate opacity only and keep the space reserved so CTAs don't jump. Ivy Chen: Proposed decision: default to inline-on-blur with touched semantics and reserved space; use a submit-summary banner when modal height < 520px or > N fields; typed-confirm for high-risk revokes. I'll update the pattern docs and add the ARIA/code snippets. Object? Marco Silva: No objections. Zoe Patel: No objections, please add mobile screenshots. Linty (a11y-bot): Logged follow-up: A11Y-5340.
